text:
This looks like a square plate of about 24 cm holding a small pile of mixed greens, mostly arugula, with a few shredded carrots. The pile covers roughly 12 x 8 cm and is loosely packed, so I estimate about 40 g of greens. Greens have very few calories, about 25 kcal per 100 g, which gives roughly 10 kcal. The leaves look slightly glossy, so there may be a little dressing, perhaps 5 g of oil at about 40 kcal. That puts the total near 50 kcal and 45 g.
